A separate data-sharing agreement sets the rules for how the district shares student data with the university and how the university protects it. Both run July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2027.

output.summary: The district is accepting $650,000 from the Eat.Learn.Play. Foundation to support its Literacy Coaches Program for students across all elementary schools. The grant covers July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, under the terms of the grant award letter.

output.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund will run the stipend process for LIFE Academy student interns in the summer work-based learning program (ECCCO). It will set up the timeline, issue payments as directed by the district coordinator, resolve problems, bill the district, and send year-end tax documents. The agreement runs April 1 through June 30, 2025, with a cap of $9,350, and it began before the board's vote.

output.summary: The board approves Personnel Report No. 2425-0009 from the Talent/Human Resources Department. The official text does not list the individual personnel actions or any dollar amounts.

output.summary: AlciDesigns & Consulting of El Sobrante will provide event planning and logistics support before and during the Linked Learning Practice Sharing event for the High School Linked Learning Department. output.headline: Lets Learning Without Limits Charter School use part of Jefferson Campus; district expects $280,068
output.summary: The board approves a one-year facilities use agreement under which Learning Without Limits Charter School partly uses the Jefferson Campus from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. The district expects $280,068.00 in revenue for 2025-26. This is an in-lieu of Proposition 39 agreement, meaning it is made in place of the charter school's standard facilities request under that law.

output.headline: Moves Urban Montessori Charter School's classroom program to Brookfield Elementary for 2025-26
output.summary: The board approves a memorandum of understanding (an agreement between the two parties) with Urban Montessori Charter School to move and continue the charter school's classroom instructional program at Brookfield Elementary School during the 2025-2026 school year. The district will also evaluate whether it makes sense to continue the program at Brookfield beyond that year. The text states no dollar amount.
